home.title: AAS targets
home.subtitle: Choose an infrastructure to browse its Asset Administration Shells.
home.signInText: Studio accesses your AAS infrastructures on your behalf. Sign in with your organization's account to continue.
home.noTargetsAdmin: Add an infrastructure to get started.
home.noTargetsUser: Ask a Studio administrator to add one.

target.authorizeText: This infrastructure uses your own account. Sign in at its identity provider so Studio can access it on your behalf.
target.waitingForBrowser: Complete the sign-in in your browser. This page updates automatically.

shell.selectElement: Select a submodel or element to see its JSON.

admin.title: Infrastructures
admin.subtitle: AAS infrastructures available to Studio users. Endpoints are probed before they are saved.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? This removes the configuration from Studio, not any data in the infrastructure.
admin.name: Name
admin.sameUrlHint: For a BaSyx AAS environment, use the same URL for all repositories.
admin.scopesHint: Include the scope that grants the infrastructure's audience, e.g. api://…/access_as_user for Entra ID.
admin.clientSecretRefHint: env:VARIABLE_NAME or file:/run/secrets/name. Leave empty to keep the current secret.
admin.clientSecretValueHint: Stored encrypted with a key from your operating system's credential store. Leave empty to keep the current secret.
admin.loopbackHostHint: 127.0.0.1 for Keycloak and other RFC 8252 providers; localhost for Microsoft Entra ID.

modeHelp.unsecured: No credentials. Only for infrastructures without access control.
modeHelp.deployment_client_credentials: Studio authenticates with its own service account (client credentials). Every user sees what this account may see.
modeHelp.delegated_user: Each user authorizes the infrastructure with their own account (authorization code with PKCE).
